# A static page is titled as the server titles it: by its frontmatter,
# then its first heading, then its file name. The description comes
# from prose, never from the tags around it.

md2html -html out src

grep -q '<title>Getting Started</title>' out/guide.html
grep -q '<title>From Frontmatter</title>' out/named.html
grep -q '<title>bare</title>' out/bare.html
grep -q '<meta name="description" content="How to begin.">' out/guide.html
! grep '<meta name="description" content="[^"]*Note' out/guide.html

-- src/guide.md --
# Getting Started

<Note>
How to begin.
</Note>

-- src/named.md --
---
title: From Frontmatter
---
# A Heading

Text.

-- src/bare.md --
Just text.
